title: Performance & Responsiveness Health
objective: Membandingkan startup, editor latency, search, graph, simulation, media, export, dan background work dengan baseline.
decision_rule: Tanpa observasi = BLOCKED tanpa klaim kesehatan; cakupan tujuh sinyal belum lengkap atau observasi tanpa catatan = FAIL; startup/editor_latency/search_latency/graph_latency/simulation_latency/export_duration ok sementara background_contention failed = FAIL contention_ignored; sinyal kerja failed sementara background_contention failed = FAIL <signal>_unrecovered (akar contention tak pernah pulih); sinyal kerja failed sementara background_contention ok = FAIL <signal>_unrecovered (latensi gagal tanpa akar contention terpulih); kegagalan terdeteksi yang pulih jujur (background_contention recovered saat latensi kerja failed, tanpa pelanggaran) = PASS konsistensi; cakupan lengkap tanpa invalidasi atau pelanggaran = PASS.
limitations: Sinyal dinilai dari observasi lokal/definisi kontrak; pengukuran performa startup/native GUI pada mesin produksi live belum diamati.
Profile-mode FrameTiming, cold-start native GUI, hosted CI, verifikasi perangkat keras, dan publikasi distribusi tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
